name: Azure DevOps Pipeline Response
description: Diagnose and resolve Azure Pipelines or branch-policy failures with guarded external updates.
approval_boundaries: Do not rerun, cancel, update, complete, or bypass policy without authorization.
Do not expose variables, secrets, or service credentials.

phases.name: Pipeline evidence
phases.instructions: Inspect pipeline runs, branch policies, logs, and PR validation state.

phases.name: Failure triage
phases.instructions: Identify the first actionable failure and likely owner.

phases.name: Local diagnosis
phases.instructions: Reproduce locally when possible and isolate the root cause.

phases.name: Environment check
phases.instructions: Check runtime, install, cache, and lockfile drift.

phases.name: Pipeline repair
phases.instructions: When evidence requires it, apply the smallest pipeline or source repair.

phases.name: Independent CI review
phases.instructions: Review the failure and repair against configured gates.

phases.name: Authorized PR update
phases.instructions: Only when authorized, rerun or update the PR or policy state required by the task.
phases.output: Remote action record or no-action disposition.

phases.name: Pipeline response handoff
phases.instructions: Report cause, repair, policy state, authorization, risk, and next action.
